summary: Iteration 46 - STEEVE-MAX Extension UX Sub-Element Dropdowns Testing Complete. ALL FEATURES VERIFIED: (1) ZONES popover (toolbar-zones-btn) opens and displays 3 sections with hierarchy labels - Zones (DOMINANT), Corridors (SECONDAIRE), Points (TERTIAIRE). (2) Zones section has 7 sub-elements all toggleable: Alimentation, Repos, Rut, Habitat, Affûts, Trajets, Multi-Engines. (3) Corridors section has 4 sub-elements all toggleable: Normaux, Intenses, EXTREME, Saisonniers. (4) Points section has 8 sub-elements all toggleable: Alimentation, Rut, Repos, Trajets, Affûts, Habitat, Centroïdes, Individuels. (5) Toggling zone sub-elements OFF/ON correctly affects map visibility. (6) Toggling corridor sub-elements including EXTREME correctly affects corridor visibility. (7) Master toggles (Zones/Corridors/Points) hide/show their sub-elements when OFF/ON. (8) POINTS CHAUDS mode still works with sub-filters. (9) Map loads correctly without JavaScript errors showing 26 zones and 19 corridors. (10) Corridors V10 master toggle works. (11) Score 55/100 displayed correctly.
